scripts.text: Only Acolyte class are applicable to join this mode.
scripts.translation: 只有服事職業才能參加此模式。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Nice work!
You might have failed
the Time Attack battle,
but you still earned a
small Arena Point reward~
scripts.translation:
[職員]
幹得不錯！
雖然你沒能通過限時挑戰，但還是能獲得少量競技場點數獎勵~

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Wait, I'm sorry, but you
have too many Arena Points.
Since you've reached the point
limitation, I can't give you any point rewards until you spend
some of your Arena Points.
scripts.translation:
[職員]
等等，抱歉，你的競技場點數已經達到上限了。
你得先花掉一些點數，我才能給你發放獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Well, let me guide
you back outside.
I hope you enjoyed
your battle in the area~
scripts.translation:
[職員]
好了，讓我送你出去吧。
希望你在競技場裡的戰鬥很愉快~

scripts.text:
[Staff]
How did you...?
According to these re-
Uh oh. These records
got messed up somehow.
Th-This isn't good at all!
Now what am I gonna do?
scripts.translation:
[職員]
你是怎麼...？
根據這些記——
哎呀，記錄怎麼亂了？
這...這下糟了！
我該怎麼辦啊？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Well, I'll give you the
benefit of the doubt and
assume you completed the
arena battle under the time
limit. So, let me give you the
standard Arena Point reward.
scripts.translation:
[職員]
好吧，我就姑且相信你在規定時間內完成了競技場戰鬥。
那就給你發放標準的競技場點數獎勵吧。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
I'm really sorry about
this, especially if you
broke some record, but
all I can do is restore your
HP and SP for you, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[職員]
真是抱歉，{0}。
要是你還打破了紀錄，那就更對不起你了，可我現在只能幫你恢復HP和SP。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Thank you.
I hope you enjoy
your time in the Arena~
scripts.translation:
[職員]
謝謝。
希望你在競技場裡玩得開心~

scripts.text:
[Staff]
^3131FF{0}^000000, right?
Hey, you did great! You
completed this Arena Battle
in {1} min and {2} seconds!
scripts.translation:
[職員]
你是^3131FF{0}^000000，對吧？
嘿，表現得真棒！
你只用了{1}分{2}秒就完成了這場競技場戰鬥！

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Currently, ^3131FF{0}^000000
is the top player, with a record
of ^3131FF{1}^000000 minutes, ^3131FF{2}^000000 seconds, of the Acolyte Class Time Force Battle.

[Staff]
Wait a second...
Your time is better
than that. Well now.
It's time I made a little
correction to the records.
scripts.translation:
[職員]
等一下...
你用的時間比這還短。
看來該更新紀錄了。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Wow! A new record!
Excellent!
scripts.translation:
[職員]
哇！新紀錄！
太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Staff]
^333333*Ahem*^000000 Oh wow!
A new record! Your
name will now be listed
under the Time Force Battle
Arena - Acolyte Class Record!
scripts.translation:
[職員]
^333333*Ahem*^000000 哇！新紀錄！
你的名字將登上競技場服事職業限時挑戰的紀錄榜！

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Alright, let me reward you
with some Arena Poi--Wait.
I can't. Your Arena Points are
already maxed out. I'm sorry,
but you'll have to spend some before you can receive more points.
scripts.translation:
[職員]
好，讓我獎勵你一些競技場點——等等。
不行，你的競技場點數已經達到上限了。
抱歉，你得先花掉一些點數，才能領取新的點數。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Anyway, you can check
your current Arena Point
total in the Arena Lobby
with Vendigos. Well, I hope
you enjoyed your battle. Now, let me guide you back outside...
scripts.translation:
[職員]
你可以去競技場大廳找文迪戈斯，查詢目前的競技場點數。
希望你打得開心。
現在讓我送你出去吧...

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Let me reward you with some
Arena Points. This time, you'll
be getting more points since
you set a new record. Please
talk with ^3131FFVendigos^000000 in the lobby
to check your new point total.
scripts.translation:
[職員]
讓我給你發放競技場點數獎勵吧。
這次你創下了新紀錄，所以獎勵的點數也會更多。
請到大廳找^3131FF文迪戈斯^000000，查詢領取獎勵後的點數總額。

scripts.text:
[Mathea]
Hello, I'm in charge of
the Acolyte Class Records
in the Arena. If you'd like to
view the other records, please
talk to the Arena Record Staff,
Owen Kheuv, and he'll help you.
scripts.translation:
[瑪西婭]
你好，我負責管理競技場的服事職業紀錄。
如果想檢視其他紀錄，請找競技場紀錄職員歐文·剋夫，他會幫助你的。

scripts.text:
[Mathea]
Would you like to
see who are the top
players in the Acolyte
Class Arena Challenges?
Please choose from the menu.
scripts.translation:
[瑪西婭]
想看看服事職業競技場挑戰的第一名是誰嗎？
請從選單中選擇。

scripts.text: Acolyte Mode
scripts.translation: 服事模式

scripts.text: Priest - Level 70 or lower
scripts.translation: 牧師 - 70級及以下

scripts.text: Priest - Level 80 or lower
scripts.translation: 牧師 - 80級及以下

scripts.text: Priest - Level 90 or lower
scripts.translation: 牧師 - 90級及以下

[Mathea]
^3131FF{0}^000000
is the top player of the
Acolyte Mode, finishing

and ^3131FF{2}^000000 seconds. Thank you
for participating in the Arena.
scripts.translation:
[瑪西婭]
服事模式的第一名是^3131FF{0}^000000，通關用時為^3131FF{1}^000000分^3131FF{2}^000000秒。
感謝你參與競技場挑戰。

scripts.text:
[Mathea]
^3131FF{0}^000000
is the top player of this

with a time of ^3131FF{1} minutes
and ^3131FF{2} seconds. Thank you
for participating in the Arena.
scripts.translation:

這個牧師模式的第一名是^3131FF{0}^000000，通關用時為^3131FF{1}分^3131FF{2}秒。
感謝你參與競技場挑戰。

scripts.text:
[Alias]
Hello there, I'm here
to inform you about
the Izlude Arena's
Acolyte Class Mode.
My name is Alias,
your Arena Guide.
scripts.translation:
[阿利亞斯]
你好，我是競技場嚮導阿利亞斯，負責為你介紹依斯魯得島競技場的服事職業模式。

scripts.text:
[Alias]
Now, there are two modes
under Acolyte Class Mode.
These are ^3131FFAcolyte Mode^000000 and
^3131FFPriest Mode^000000. For both modes,
you will need to wait inside the ^3131FFAcolyte Class Waiting Room^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿利亞斯]
服事職業模式分為^3131FF服事模式^000000和^3131FF牧師模式^000000。
無論選擇哪一種，都需要先到^3131FF服事職業等待室^000000等候。

scripts.text:
[Alias]
Once it's your turn,
you'll be sent out of the
waiting room and guided to
the arena grounds. Oh, and
the entrance fee is 1,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[阿利亞斯]
輪到你時，就會把你從等待室送到競技場。
哦，對了，入場費是1,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Alias]
It'll be handy to know
that the Red Plants and
Permeters in the Acolyte
Class Mode will drop items
and give experience. Other
monsters, however, won't.
scripts.translation:
[阿利亞斯]
有一點你可以記住：服事職業模式中的紅草和果樹龜會掉落物品，也會提供經驗值，其他魔物則不會。

scripts.text:
[Alias]
Once you've been guided
to the actual arena grounds,
listen to ^3131FFTrocco^000000 for the mission objectives that you will have to
complete within the time limit
of ^3131FF8 minutes^000000. Don't forget~
scripts.translation:
[阿利亞斯]
進入競技場後，請聽^3131FF特羅科^000000說明任務目標。
你必須在^3131FF8分鐘^000000內完成任務，別忘了哦~

scripts.text:
[Alias]
Upon completing the
entire stage, you will be
warped to the ^3131DDFinale Waiting
Room^000000 where you'll be rewarded
with Arena Points. But you must get your points within 1 minute.
scripts.translation:
[阿利亞斯]
完成整個關卡後，你會被傳送到^3131DD最終等待室^000000，領取競技場點數獎勵。
記得必須在1分鐘內領取。

scripts.text:
[Alias]
Once you're automatically
sent outside of the Finale
Waiting Room, you won't have
the chance to get your Arena
Points if you didn't get them
there, so be careful~
scripts.translation:
[阿利亞斯]
一旦被自動送出最終等待室，沒領的競技場點數就再也領不到了，千萬留意哦~

scripts.text:
[Alias]
Well, I hope you enjoy
the Acolyte Mode Arena!
Good luck and good fighting!
scripts.translation:
[阿利亞斯]
希望你在服事模式競技場玩得開心！
祝你好運，戰鬥順利！
